title: Amazon, Microsoft Partner on 750 Million Liter Water Replenishment Project
key_facts: Amazon and Microsoft announced a water replenishment project in Hesse, Germany, expected to return more than 750 million liters of water a year to local groundwater.
NABU (Naturschutzbund Deutschland) will restore wetlands across 40 hectares in the Vogelsberg region, a key source of drinking water for Frankfurt, funded by both companies.
Methods: removing artificial drainage, creating shallow water zones, extensive grassland management.
NABU will work with about 10 local landholders to acquire 80 hectares near Herbstein, with more acquisitions planned through 2028.
Biodiversity will be monitored annually between 2028 and 2038.
Microsoft says it reached its water positive target for the first time in 2025; Amazon says it is 75% of the way to its goal.
quote_evidence: Tech giants Amazon and Microsoft announced a new water replenishment project in Hesse, Germany, aimed at restoring natural wetland conditions and replenishing local groundwater resources, expected to return more than 750 million liters of water annually to the local groundwater supply.
The project will restore wetlands across 40 hectares through nature-based approaches
why_it_matters_hint: Big cloud companies are funding local water projects as scrutiny of data center water use grows.
